throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: fstx.s $f0, $r20, $r12; fstx.s $f1, $r20, $r13; fstx.s $f2, $r20, $r14; fstx.s $f3, $r20, $r15; fstx.s $f4, $r20, $r16; fstx.s $f5, $r20, $r17; fstx.s $f6, $r20, $r18; fstx.s $f7, $r20, $r19
throughput.init: addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; addi.d $r12, $r0, 0; addi.d $r13, $r0, 8; addi.d $r14, $r0, 16; addi.d $r15, $r0, 24; addi.d $r16, $r0, 32; addi.d $r17, $r0, 40; addi.d $r18, $r0, 48; addi.d $r19, $r0, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 0x3ff0000000000000; movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r4; addi.d $r12, $r0, 0; addi.d $r13, $r0, 8; addi.d $r14, $r0, 16; addi.d $r15, $r0, 24; addi.d $r16, $r0, 32; addi.d $r17, $r0, 40; addi.d $r18, $r0, 48; addi.d $r19, $r0, 56' --asm 'fstx.s $f0, $r20, $r12; fstx.s $f1, $r20, $r13; fstx.s $f2, $r20, $r14; fstx.s $f3, $r20, $r15; fstx.s $f4, $r20, $r16; fstx.s $f5, $r20, $r17; fstx.s $f6, $r20, $r18; fstx.s $f7, $r20, $r19'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: Throughput measured with a 1KB stack buffer. Latency not measured; memory latency depends on cache state.
